verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo → can → headline → CTA column clean and the can at a good size, but it shrinks the teal circle into a floating full circle that no longer bleeds off the edge, and the right green can dot nearly touches that circle. The bottom-left circle is also token-sized, and the legal line is tiny and pushed to the bottom. B keeps the circles big and bleeding like the original, but the GLACIER logo and the top of the can now sit on the teal circle. The fine print runs across the edge of the oversized bottom circle, and a dead band is left below it, so the bottom looks unresolved and the layout feels top-heavy.
